text:
erin: heads up — we're getting p99 tail spikes on the continuous-batcher path, started ~22:40 UTC, a few customer T1s reported timeouts
cheng: looking... can you drop the grafana panel link?
tanvi: https://grafana.redwood/inv/XYZ — p95 from 120ms -> 300ms, p99 from 420ms -> 1.2s over last 15m :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
ops-bot: [ALERT] route=continuous-batcher p99>1s for model:open-vicuna-13B (triggered at 22:41:12 UTC)
kevin: rolled out batcher change earlier today to increase max_hold_ms from 8 -> 60 to try to improve throughput for mid-size prompts. that could explain more waiting for small prompts
liz: grabbing recent logs from one affected shard, snippet:
```
2026-03-16T22:40:31Z batcher[shard-7]: formed batch size=1 wait_ms=60 queued_for=61 tail_latency_ms=1183
2026-03-16T22:40:32Z batcher[shard-7]: flush due to timeout batch_size=1
```
sam: repro on staging with lots of 3-token prompts and burstiness—observed same tail. batching knobs interact badly with tiny prompts.
erin: customers are hitting timeouts and rate limits because retries pile up.
cheng: mitigation options: 1) rollback max_hold_ms to previous 8ms 2) set early_flush_min_batch=1 for continuous route 3) short-circuit small requests to sync path via routing-rule
tanvi: I can patch a rollout to set early_flush_min_batch=1 on continuous in staging, then promote to prod canary 10% — want that first?
kevin: do safe canary. also add metric 'flush_reason' to see timeout vs size on next hour
liz: i'll prepare quick rollback PR to revert the change if canary shows no improvement
sam: quick temporary fix we used before: reroute customer-tenant X to dedicated runner until resolved
erin: agreed — go canary with early-flush min batch=1, and sam please reroute the 2 highest-impact customers
cheng: creating incident ticket and adding runbook steps. tagging eng-oncall to follow.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0316-1042. Assigned: eng-sre
kevin: after canary, let's run a targeted load of ~500qps of 3-token prompts to validate
erin: thanks team — keep updates in thread, escalate if p99 stays >1s after canary
